name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: REINIT-CERTVERIFIER-EXPERIMENT BUILD (v4): 0.4.33 fixed the performance.now() crash and the user confirmed a real result -- reading now self-heals after every send, not just the first occurrence per session, the first mechanism all session to actually change that pattern. 0.4.33's own log showed a second, same-category bug though: waitForObserverTopic()'s timeout guard used setTimeout(), also not a global in this scope, throwing ReferenceError right after the enterprise-roots pref was set to true. The underlying fix still worked despite this -- the pref value change itself (confirmed via readback) is what triggers Gecko's C++-side CertVerifier rebuild, independent of our own JS-side wait/confirm bookkeeping -- but the crash meant our success/failure logging was unreliable and, in an original-pref-was-false scenario, could have skipped restoring the pref afterward. Fixes by importing setTimeout/clearTimeout from resource://gre/modules/Timer.sys.mjs (Gecko's polyfill for privileged scopes lacking Window's own timers).
